events.title: Mail ballots and early voting begin
events.description: Mail ballots are delivered to the U.S. Postal Service; early voting begins.

events.title: Regular MUSD Board Meeting
events.location: Joshua Tree Elementary School · 4950 Sunburst Ave., Joshua Tree
events.description: Watch for budget, school-boundary, enrollment and receiving-school items. Check the official agenda.

events.title: Z107.7 MUSD Trustee Area 5 Candidate Forum
events.description: Live on-air forum hosted by Gary Daigneault with candidates for MUSD Trustee Area 5. Podcast available later.

events.title: Voter registration deadline
events.description: Last day for ordinary online registration or postmarking a registration application for the Nov. 3 election. Conditional registration remains available in person afterward.

events.title: MUSD Board Study Session — Budget Stabilization and Enrollment
events.location: Joshua Tree Professional Development Center · 6061 Sunburst Ave., Joshua Tree
events.description: Board study session scheduled for 8:30 AM. The district is expected to review enrollment, ACCE/alternative programs and budget stabilization; check the posted agenda for the final scope and any changes.

events.title: General Election / MUSD Board election
events.description: Election Day; polls are open 7 AM–8 PM. Three MUSD trustee seats are on the ballot.

events.title: Regular MUSD Board of Education Meeting
events.location: Time and venue to be verified against the official agenda
events.description: Next regular Board meeting scheduled for November 10. Meeting time, location and agenda not yet independently verified; consult the district before attending.
